transcript: Speaker A (Robot): हाथ में झोला लेकर इतनी सुबह कहाँ जा रही हैं? [Where are you going so early in the morning with a bag in your hand?] Speaker B (Woman): I Going Market Buy Vegetables. Speaker A (Robot): इसे ऐसे बोलिए, I am going to the market to buy vegetables. [Say it like this, I am going to the market to buy vegetables.] Speaker B (Woman): मुझे इंग्लिश बोलने में हिचकिचाहट होती है। [I feel hesitant speaking English.] Speaker A (Robot): रोज़ थोड़ी प्रैक्टिस करेंगी तो कॉन्फिडेंस आ जाएगा। [If you practice a little every day, you will gain confidence.] Speaker B (Woman): पर प्रैक्टिस कैसे करूँ? [But how do I practice?] Speaker A (Robot): SpeakEasy App के साथ। [With the SpeakEasy App.] Speaker B (Woman): और उसमें क्या होता है? [Oh, is it expensive?] Speaker A (Robot): नहीं, सिर्फ ₹1 से शुरुआत कर सकती हैं। [No, you can start with just ₹1.] Speaker B (Woman): मैं आज ही इंस्टॉल करती हूँ। [I will install it today.] Speaker C (Presenter): अभी SpeakEasy App डाउनलोड करें और फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the SpeakEasy App now and start speaking fluent English.]

summary: An AI robot corrects a woman's English during a market walk and introduces the Speakeasy app as a personal AI tutor. The app offers English practice explained in Hindi starting at just ₹1. A final presenter calls on viewers to download the app to speak English fluently.
